steps.command:
(set -euo pipefail
exec 9>/tmp/project0-m4-01a0fcfa-validation.lock
flock -n 9
state_root="$(mktemp -d /tmp/project0-m4-checkpoint-validation.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf -- "$state_root"' EXIT
export XDG_DATA_HOME="$state_root/data" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$state_root/config" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$state_root/cache"
export PROJECT0_TEST_STATE_DIR="$state_root/runtime" DASHBOARD_RESULTS_DIR="$state_root/dashboard"
export M4_SOURCE_REVISION="$(git rev-parse --verify HEAD)"
[[ "$M4_SOURCE_REVISION" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
mkdir -p "$PROJECT0_TEST_STATE_DIR" build/validation
result_dir="$(mktemp -d build/validation/checkpoint-focused.XXXXXX)"
timeout --kill-after=15s 90s godot --headless --import > "$result_dir/bootstrap.log" 2>&1
timeout --kill-after=15s 120s godot --headless -s addons/gut/gut_cmdln.gd -gselect=test_m4_checkpoint_attribution -gjunit_xml_file="$result_dir/gut.xml" -gdisable_colors -gexit > "$result_dir/gut.log" 2>&1
)
